title: Concept: Yarn checksum mismatches ignored
description: .yarnrc.yml declares a Yarn setting that ignores a cached-archive checksum mismatch, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A corrupted or substituted archive installs without any error, which removes the one check that would notice the substitution.
risk: A corrupted or substituted archive installs without any error, which removes the one check that would notice the substitution.
